g.text: Graph revision AC - ga_side: Keys: 800 overall depth (-Y rear guard plane at 0, +Y guide rail outer face at 800); deck spans x 60..800
Graph revision AC - ga_side: Mould seats under the deck: backing platen z 502..548, jacket shell t6 z 486..602, insert cavity opens into the seat from above
Graph revision AC - ga_side: Melt path below the deck: refractory trough invert z 100 (inversion 100 mm), distribution header feeding both bottom-fill risers, drain well under the deck at x 340
Graph revision AC - ga_side: Pour station: ladle shell OD280 x 240 (top z 850), tilt post and arm above the deck, trunnion lugs bolted under the arm saddle
Graph revision AC - ga_side: Runout roller table x 800..1500: solid rollers D70 x 520 on D20 end shafts in 2-bolt pillow blocks; bearer rails overlap the frame rails
Graph revision AC - ga_side: General tolerance ISO 2768-m unless noted
